detail.longDescription: Sometimes I have to do maintenance work on my webcomic site that is essential but also invisible to most people and keeps me from drawing pages, which can give the impression I've been doing nothing. This week I did site security chores: Updating php, setting basic brute-force attack protections and, in general, weeding out mistakes in my security practices (there where many but that's how you learn). # webcomic # webtoons # webdev # php
